top_signals.title: Appointment of Chair and Deputy Chair of the Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC)
top_signals.summary: Following an external recruitment process, the Bank of England (the Bank) has appointed Nicholas Segal as Chair of its Enforcement Decision Making Committee (EDMC), and Peter King as Deputy Chair, with effect from 1 August 2026.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nvidia jumps 6% after blockbuster earnings boost AI confidence
top_signals.summary: Nvidia shares rose on Thursday after the chip giant's revenue guidance reassured investors that AI demand will remain strong.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Okta skyrockets 20%, CrowdStrike surges 15% as rising AI threat boosts earnings
top_signals.summary: AI adoption is pushing customers to spend more on cybersecurity tools from companies such as CrowdStrike and Okta
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Salesforce stock jumps 18% on AI growth and Anthropic investment gain
top_signals.summary: Salesforce's Anthropic stake led to higher profit in the latest quarter.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Valuation Methodology Review for Pubs and Hotels
top_signals.summary: The government is launching an independent review of the valuation methodology used for pub and hotel business rates valuations and inviting stakeholders to submit evidence.

top_signals.summary: The Marine Corps introduced the Squad Aiming Laser to students at its North Carolina school.

top_signals.title: Chainalysis says global crypto taxable activity topped $457 billion in 2025
top_signals.summary: Chainalysis estimates at least $457 billion in onchain taxable crypto activity in 2025, with CARF covering only 14%.
